title: Precompiled include set
summary: Test a list of path strings against a fixed set of already-compiled glob patterns, true when any pattern matches.
notes: The ten include patterns are compiled once at adapter load, outside the measured call, in every adapter but one: Ruby File.fnmatch? has no compile step and interprets the patterns for every path. Each operation tests 250 paths and returns a list of booleans (matches any pattern). Rust describes results as JSON outside timing.
